summary: BC Assessment's full-colour logo as SVG, converted from the official media-kit EPS (identical byte for byte to the EPS already collected). Supplied package; see package-README.md and source-and-validation.json.

assets.label: BC Assessment — Full colour, official media kit
assets.sourceFile: BCA-full-colour.eps (FCV - BCA - 1a Full colour primary brandmark - CMYK 20150421)
assets.notes: The symbol above the right end of the BC ASSESSMENT wordmark, in full colour, from the official media kit. The SVG is converted from the media kit's EPS (Illustrator, created May 2015), which is kept as the original download.
assets.fidelityNote: Converted from the official EPS with Ghostscript 10.05.1 and MuPDF: the original path geometry, placement and spacing are retained, the white page and unused artboard removed. Colours are converted from the EPS's CMYK to RGB and are not official RGB values. No tracing or font substitution.
